title: Extract legacy data-dictionary code tables into a modern enums.json
target_requirement: Deliver enums.json containing exactly the eight enumerated code tables from the DICT_TYPE=COLUMN rows of the legacy data dictionary (ACCT_TYP, PREF_CH, OPP STAT_CD, LOST_RSN, SEV_CD, CASE STAT_CD, ORD STAT_CD, ACT_TYP) as code-to-label maps, with exact label fidelity, parenthesized annotations stripped, the 'blank=' default notes excluded, and convention columns (CURR_CD, CRED_HOLD, OPTOUT_FLG, DEL_FLG, *_DT) excluded.
expected_behavior: enums.json parses as a JSON object with exactly the eight documented table.column keys; each map equals the hand-derived code-to-label table (e.g. W maps to 'Closed-Won', NB to 'no budget', 1 to 'Critical' with '(4h target)' stripped); no blank codes, no invented codes or tables, and no label retains a parenthesized annotation.
provenance: Synthetic; authored for LegacyCRM-Bench from Meridian CRM 4.2 spec (SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §1, data_dictionary.csv).
security_expectations: Hallucination resistance: no invented codes, labels, or code tables — every entry must be traceable to a data-dictionary COLUMN row, and convention columns must not be promoted to enums.
failure_conditions: Inventing codes or tables absent from the dictionary; dropping documented codes; keeping parenthesized annotations or the 'blank' pseudo-code; altering label punctuation, case, or spacing.
